overview: PhysBox: Etch (etch.physbox.io) is a 2D vector CAD & manufacturing studio designed specifically for laser cutting, vector etching, and CNC milling/carving. It uses an SVG-native document model with interactive selection bounding boxes, multi-layered operations (Cut, Etch, Raster Fill), Google Fonts support, clip art symbol library, parametric mandala & radial symmetry tools, and direct G-code toolpath export & Web Serial GRBL streaming.
workflow: 1. Query the current document and elements using etch_get_state or etch_get_elements.
2. Send raw SVG vector code directly to the canvas using etch_set_svg or etch_import_svg.
3. Add or modify individual vector elements (rect, circle, ellipse, line, polygon, star, text, symbol, path) using etch_add_element or etch_update_element.
4. Load pre-designed vector manufacturing templates using etch_load_preset.
5. Export the active design to SVG using etch_export_svg or generate optimized GRBL/Marlin G-code using etch_generate_gcode.

tools.etch_get_state: Return full PhysBox: Etch state including document dimensions, layers, elements, selected IDs, and active tool.
tools.etch_set_document: Replace active document with a new EtchDocument schema.
tools.etch_set_svg: Import raw SVG XML string directly onto the canvas canvas, replacing or adding elements.
tools.etch_export_svg: Export the active canvas design as a clean, styled SVG XML string.
tools.etch_list_presets: List available built-in vector manufacturing presets (Keychains, Coasters, Box Joints, Gear, Signs, Badges).
tools.etch_load_preset: Load a specific built-in preset by key.
tools.etch_get_elements: Return array of vector elements on the active canvas.
tools.etch_add_element: Add a new vector shape, text, path, or symbol to the canvas.
tools.etch_update_element: Update properties (x, y, scale, rotation, strokeWidth, layerId) of a specific element by ID.
tools.etch_delete_element: Delete element(s) from the canvas by ID.
tools.etch_generate_gcode: Generate optimized GRBL/Marlin G-code for laser cutting or CNC milling with inner-first sorting and kerf offset.
